statement: (ι : Type) (V : Finset ι) (δs : ι → ℝ) (hδs : ∀ i, δs i > 0) : ∃ δ > 0, ∀ i ∈ V, δ ≤ δs i
name: RealAnalysisGame.FinMinPos
content: Given an indexing type `ι`, a finite subset `V` of `ι`, and a function `δs : ι → ℝ` that assigns a positive real number to each index, there exists a positive real number `δ` such that for all indices `i` in the finite set `V`, `δ` is less than or equal to `δs i`.
